description: This Java class implements a command strategy for fetching datatable entries based on a query within the Apache Fineract project. It processes batch requests, extracts query parameters from the URL, invokes the DatatablesApiResource to retrieve data, and constructs the batch response accordingly.

classes.name: GetDatatableEntryByQueryCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy class that handles fetching datatable entries based on query parameters in batch requests within the Fineract project. It integrates with the DatatablesApiResource to retrieve data and constructs BatchResponse objects.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch command to retrieve datatable entries by parsing URL query parameters, invoking the API resource, and returning a BatchResponse with the data.
